SELECT SCHEDULE_NO , USER_ID , SCHEDULE_NAME , SCHEDULE_CONTENT FROM SCHEDULE

WITH base_applicants AS ( SELECT applicant_id FROM applicant WHERE user_id = #{userId} ) SELECT ar.applicant_id, rp.recruitment_no, rn.recruitment_title, rn.user_id, rp.recruit_process_step AS step, rp.recruit_process_type AS step_type, ar.STEP_PASS_YN AS pass, rp.recruit_process_final AS final, re.recruit_exam_name, TO_CHAR(re.recruit_exam_start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS exam_datetime, i.interview_location, i.interview_type, CASE WHEN i.interview_type = 'Y' THEN TO_CHAR(ar.evaluation_start_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') ELSE TO_CHAR(i.interview_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') END AS interview_datetime FROM applicant_record ar JOIN recruit_process rp ON ar.recruit_process_no = rp.recruit_process_no JOIN recruitment_notice rn ON rp.recruitment_no = rn.recruitment_no LEFT JOIN recruitment_exam re ON rp.recruit_process_no = re.process_no LEFT JOIN interview i ON rp.recruit_process_no = i.process_no WHERE ar.applicant_id IN (SELECT applicant_id FROM base_applicants) AND rn.recruitment_del_date is null

SELECT c.RECRUITMENT_NO , c.USER_ID , c.RECRUITMENT_TITLE , c.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE , c.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE FROM scrab_company sc JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE c ON sc.company_id = c.user_id WHERE sc.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT c.RECRUITMENT_NO , c.USER_ID , c.RECRUITMENT_TITLE , c.RECRUITMENT_STARTDATE , c.RECRUITMENT_FINISH_DATE FROM scrab_recruitment sr JOIN RECRUITMENT_NOTICE c ON sr.RECRUITMENT_NO = c.RECRUITMENT_NO WHERE sr.USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT SCHEDULE_NO , USER_ID , SCHEDULE_NAME , SCHEDULE_CONTENT , TO_CHAR(SCHEDULE_START_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as scheduleStartDate , TO_CHAR(SCHEDULE_END_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') as scheduleEndDate FROM SCHEDULE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
